substantial.authors: Marcos Cardozo and Jose Ignacio Rivero-Wildemauwe
substantial.scope: Author-reported 588 million trades and 2.48 million wallets, November 2022 through March 2026, Akey et al. dataset version 1.3. Not recomputed here.
substantial.claim: Dollar-weighted purchases below 10 cents lose about 19.3 cents per dollar; purchases at or above 90 cents earn about 0.83 cents. Equal-weighted longshots lose 6.3 cents; parent-event weighting reverses the longshot sign to a gain of 4.1 cents. Sports does not show the classic tail pattern.
substantial.limit: Does not test the 0.55-0.60 price bucket at seven days that EDGE_VERDICT left open. Sports exception is not a measured trading rule.

substantial.scope: 2024 US presidential markets on Polymarket, on-chain settlement ledger. Not a billion-trade study.
substantial.claim: October Trump-market volume is 958 million USD under raw OrderFilled aggregation and 391 million USD of exchange-equivalent turnover under the paper's decomposition.
substantial.limit: Figures were read from the paper. The ledger was not re-aggregated here.

substantial.authors: Allen Sirolly, Hongyao Ma, Yash Kanoria and Rajiv Sethi
substantial.scope: Author-reported 1.26 million wallets. Algorithm classifies about 25 percent of historical volume as wash-consistent and 14 percent of wallets.
substantial.claim: Wash-consistent volume peaked near 60 percent of weekly volume in December 2024, fell below 5 percent by May 2025, and rose to about 20 percent in early October 2025. Sports 45 percent, election 17 percent, politics 12 percent, crypto 3 percent, all author-reported.
substantial.limit: No ground truth. Not reimplemented here. Category peaks are estimates.

substantial.scope: Trump-YES contract only, 5 January to 5 November 2024. About 814,678 buys and 813,000 sells, roughly 1.6 million transactions. Not the whole venue.
substantial.claim: Informed wallets are defined from at least 20 market orders, size and subsequent price moves. The paper's own definition is outcome-conditioned.
substantial.limit: Selecting informed traders from later performance is not a point-in-time detector. Not recomputed.

substantial.scope: Vendor essay. No wallet list, no test set, no code.
substantial.claim: The firm says it covers more than 20 prediction-market platforms and that clustering can link addresses. One omitted market-maker week exceeded 2.5 billion USD of deposits.
substantial.limit: Private infrastructure. Nothing here can be replayed.

substantial.scope: 78,496 longshot bets and 12,355 wallets on settled markets through 5 May 2026, as stated on the page.
substantial.claim: 152 military Orca wallets, more than 8 million USD, average return 132 percent versus losses for whales and bots. No address list.
substantial.limit: Page read. No microdata. Not reproduced.

substantial.authors: Vincent Gregoire and coauthors, dataset card
substantial.scope: Card states 2022-11-11 to 2026-03-29, reconciled end-user trades from OrderFilled. It does not print a trade count.
substantial.claim: markets.parquet has 729133 rows and events.parquet has 316429 rows, counted here with DuckDB. The approximately 588 million trades were not counted.
substantial.limit: CC-BY 4.0 covers the authors' processing, not Polymarket question text. The trade hive was not downloaded.

snippet.limit: The public article HTML at https://inca.digital/intelligence/polymarket-insider-report/ did not include addresses or the method. Not reproduced.

snippet.limit: Snippet only. No address list in the text retrieved. A high win rate is not proof of non-public information.
